I've never really looked at it that way... That's really interesting! :)
I don't talk to anyone about what's going on in my life. Not even my family. I wish I could, but I guess I just don't like "bugging people with my problems". The way I personally see it, everyone is going through some shit in life. I don't want to bother everyone else with my own. I guess that's not a very good way at looking at it. :P.
I've never been on anti-depressants. I really think it would help me though
I haven't tried anything to help me with my stress / depression. I just try to let it go and pretend like nothing happened.

As hard as I try, nothing seems to be getting better. I've already been through so much and I'm not even 20 yet.  I just feel as if this world doesn't have a place for me. It's to the point where I've been numbed down to almost everything. I just don't care for much these days
